original_sentence: "Automation systems designed to make the process more idiot-proof are trying to bridge that gap," says Stefan Chomka, the editor of Restaurant magazine.
translation: 《Restaurant》杂志编辑 Stefan Chomka 说：“旨在让流程更不容易出错的自动化系统正在努力填补这一缺口。”

key_vocabulary.usage_note: bridge that gap 在本句中对应"填补缺口"。
editor of 在本句中对应"……的编辑"。
automation systems 在本句中对应"自动化系统"。
idiot-proof 在本句中对应"不易出错的；傻瓜式的"。
